solicitations.title: Solicitations
solicitations.description: One record per open public-sector solicitation (RFP, IFB, RFQ, RFI) from a US state procurement portal: state, number, title, agency, type, dates, NIGP/UNSPSC codes, buyer contact and attachment links.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Per-portal counts and skip reasons for this run, stored as the SUMMARY record in the default key-value store.
